ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, which species receives energy from the mouse?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a food web, labeled hawk, snake, mouse, rabbit, wildflowers, grass. mouse is located at the lower right of the diagram, and snake is located above and slightly to the right of mouse. Observing the arrows connected to mouse, there is an arrow pointing upward from mouse to snake. Arrows in a food web indicate the direction of energy flow to the organism receiving energy, so the species receiving energy from mouse is snake.
